description: This file contains functions and data structures related to managing Go module vendoring, including checking if vendoring is enabled, retrieving main module info, and handling workspace vendoring, with specific focus on Go version 1.14+.

classes.name: ModuleJSON
classes.description: Struct holding information about a Go module, including path, version, directory, and dependencies.

methods.name: VendorEnabled
methods.description: Determines if vendoring is enabled based on module info, environment variables, and Go version.

methods.name: getMainModuleAnd114
methods.description: Retrieves main module info and checks if Go version is 1.14 or higher.

methods.name: WorkspaceVendorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if workspace vendoring is enabled by inspecting GOWORK environment variable.

methods.name: getWorkspaceMainModules
methods.description: Retrieves information about main modules in the workspace.
